title: Nutty Venezuelan Patties Empanadas
description: A dense and nutty twist on traditional Venezuelan empanadas, perfect for a sick day. This recipe is low-carb-friendly and can be easily prepared at home.

ingredients.name: Ground Beef
ingredients.notes: 80/20 lean to fat ratio works best

instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the ground beef, chopped onion, minced garlic, cumin, and salt until well combined.
Divide the mixture into 8 equal parts and shape each part into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape, about 1/8 inch thick.
Place a tablespoon of grated queso fresco in the center of each disk, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Fold the dough over the cheese and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Use a fork to crimp the edges and create a decorative border.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with beaten egg and sprinkle with chopped pecans.
Bake the empanadas in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
While the empanadas are baking, heat a large skillet over medium-high heat with 1/2 inch of vegetable oil.
When the empanadas are done baking, heat the oil in the skillet to 375°F (190°C).
Fry the empanadas in batches until golden brown and crispy, about 2-3 minutes on each side.
Drain the empanadas on paper towels and serve hot.
Optional: Serve with a side of salsa or guacamole for added flavor.
